name: Remote control and monitoring
description: Controls or watches Virtual Serial Studio on the other computer of a seat, over a mutually authenticated TLS 1.3 connection to one paired computer.

permissions.name: ports.read
permissions.reason: Lists ports and links for the other computer of the seat.

permissions.name: net.listen
permissions.reason: Accepts the one paired computer. Loopback unless the setting listen_address names an address.

permissions.name: net.outbound
permissions.reason: Connects to the one paired computer, at the address in the pairing.

permissions.name: traffic.tap
permissions.reason: Lets the paired computer watch traffic bytes, only when the pairing allows it.

permissions.name: ports.write
permissions.reason: Lets the paired computer send bytes, only when the pairing allows control.

permissions.name: topology.modify
permissions.reason: Lets the paired computer create and link ports, only when the pairing allows control.

permissions.name: data.private
permissions.reason: Keeps its identity key and the pairing in its own data folder.

extension_points.name: Remote control and monitoring
extension_points.description: Relays the control API between the two computers of a seat.

label.en: This computer is controlled or watched
This computer controls or watches the other
Address to put in the pairing (needed only when listening on every address)
What the other computer may do
Watch, and make and fetch recordings

help.en: Shown when Studio asks you to approve this plugin. It is only a name you choose.
Set on the computer that is watched or controlled. The pairing code appears in the status for five minutes. Set it off to cancel.

label.en: Pairing code from the other computer

help.en: Set on the computer that watches or controls: paste the code shown in the status of the other one. It is used once and not kept.
Set on to forget the pairing and end the session. Pair again to use the plugin.
